metadata.title: Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Adapting Farms with NASA Data: Kansas Benchmark Farms

benchmark_farms.label: Tribune High Plains Dryland & Pivot Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Located in Tribune, this pin sits squarely within an active center-pivot irrigated agricultural field operating over the declining Ogallala Aquifer. The demonstration models SMAP root-zone soil moisture stress thresholds to guide termination timing for cereal rye cover crops, preventing pre-plant soil water depletion before planting grain sorghum.

benchmark_farms.label: Colby Northwest Plateau Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Situated north of Colby in a contiguous dryland and irrigated crop section, this coordinate tests ECOSTRESS evaporative stress index (ESI) and Landsat NDVI vegetation indices during intense July heatwaves. The workflow optimizes deficit irrigation schedules and evaluates winter wheat-to-corn rotation transitions.

benchmark_farms.label: Hays Research & Dryland Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Positioned near Hays in an active silt-loam dryland production field, this site integrates GPM IMERG sub-daily precipitation data. It simulates whether late-summer rainfall pulses justify establishing forage radish or winter pea cover crops immediately following winter wheat harvest.

benchmark_farms.label: Salina Smoky Hill Valley Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Located within the agricultural valley surrounding Salina, this field anchors multi-species cover crop trials. Sentinel-2 and Landsat phenology trackers monitor multi-species mix canopy cover and root biomass accumulation designed to suppress herbicide-resistant weeds and build soil organic carbon ahead of double-crop soybeans.

benchmark_farms.label: Manhattan River Valley Agronomy Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Sited in the fertile river bottomlands adjacent to Manhattan, this benchmark utilizes NASA POWER daily growing degree days (GDD) and soil temperature analytics. It manages cereal rye termination timing 14 days prior to high-yield corn planting to prevent early-season nitrogen immobilization.

benchmark_farms.label: Ottawa Marais des Cygnes Valley Farm
benchmark_farms.demo_story: Situated in the eastern agricultural floodplains near Ottawa, this site monitors GRACE terrestrial water storage anomalies and GPM heavy precipitation events. The model manages spring waterlogging risks and quantifies biological nitrogen fixation credits generated by winter legume cover crops.
